title: Idiot Totem of undying
description: This resource pack change your totem texture, particle and sound to Idiot meme (You're an Idiot, hahahahhahahaha!)
body:
THIS RESOURCE PACK CHANGE THE TOTEM'S TEXTURE, SOUND AND PARTICLE TO "YOU ARE AN IDIOT" MEME

> _The totem's sound is a little bit long and noisy if totem pops many times. I'm making a second version that makes the sound shorter_
